text:
Marta - CS Ops: Heads up — the playbook automation re-fired outbound touchpoints for ~1.2k accounts during last night's run, looks like the idempotency key wasn't persisted for a subset. :grimacing:
Sam - Enablement: Yikes. Any PHI/PII exposures or just duplicate activities logged in CRM?
Marta - CS Ops: Mostly duplicate task/event rows and a few duplicate emails queued (we throttled outbound send). No PII exfiltration detected.
Devon - Product: Do we know which code path missed the key? Alan, can you correlate with the kafka offsets/consumer lag?
Alan - Data Eng: Early look — the worker that writes the playbook state crashed mid-commit on ~1.2k events; it retried without the write-ahead idempotency flag. Query I used to find duplicates:
```sql
SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM crm.activities
WHERE source = 'playbook-run-2026-03-20'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Marta - CS Ops: Oof. We should avoid manual edits in CRM. Plan: 1) run a dry-run repair job to mark duplicates (no deletes) 2) patch the worker to persist idempotency flag atomically 3) schedule a controlled correction with owner review. Thoughts?
Sam - Enablement: Agree. Also need to notify CS reps and provide a short script to ignore duplicate task notifications today. Could we add a quick saved filter in CRM for duplicate-created-date = yesterday?
Devon - Product: I'll open a quick PR with the atomic commit. For the dry-run, can we produce a human-readable CSV of affected accounts + duplicated activity ids so CS can sample?
Alan - Data Eng: Yup. Dry-run will output CSV. Running it now as job: pb-dryrun-3467890123. Expected runtime ~6m.
playbook-bot: Dry run job queued — id=pb-dryrun-3467890123, owner=Marta, mode=dry-run. Will post results to #customer-success when complete.
Marta - CS Ops: Perfect. Once we have CSV, Sam can coordinate a 30-min review with reps and pick a 1% sample to validate. If safe, we run a conservative dedupe that marks duplicates with tag=dupe_correction_candidate (no deletion).
Sam - Enablement: I'll prep the review doc and a short training note on what to ignore. Also propose adding a temporary UI flag in CRM that hides events with tag=dupe_correction_candidate for reps to reduce noise.
Devon - Product: After patching worker, let's add an automated unit/integration test around idempotency and add a post-deploy check that validates no duplicate keys were emitted.
Alan - Data Eng: Dry-run finished. Output: 1,234 accounts; CSV uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/pb-dryrun-3467890123.csv :white_check_mark:
Marta - CS Ops: Thanks. Sam, can you schedule the 30-min review at 11:30 PT? If reps thumbs-up, we'll run the tagging job at 12:15 PT and monitor healthscore deltas for the next 24h.
Sam - Enablement: Scheduled and invited. Adding a short checklist to the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Devon - Product: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/playbook-service/pull/789 — patch persists idempotency key with transactional write. Requesting review.
Marta - CS Ops: Great work team. Post-mitigation action items: update runbooks, add a metric for duplicate-activity-rate to the Console, and run a one-off healthscore recalibration job if we see >0.5% upward noise in activity counts.
playbook-bot: Noted actions created: #78912 (runbook update), #78913 (metric), #78914 (recalibration watch).
Marta - CS Ops: Closing out here — will post summary to the CS handbook after the tagging job completes. Thanks all. :heart:
